aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Citragupta, O Lord;
Master, victory to you, Citragupta, O Lord.
You bring to fulfilment the fruit your devotees wish for.
aarti.pad1: You destroy obstacles, bring good fortune
and give joy to the saints.
your glory has spread over the three worlds.
aarti.pad2: Your form is four-armed, your image dark,
and a yellow silk robe shines upon you.
aarti.pad3: You remove suffering and destroy the wicked;
you are the Lord who dwells within all.
Destroyer of creation, remover of people's sorrow,
aarti.pad4: look most splendid in your hand.
The vaijayantī garland of forest flowers
charms the hearts of the three worlds.
aarti.pad5: You took up the office of the throne,
aarti.pad6: King Saudāsa and Bhīṣma the grandsire
you gave them the fruit they wished for.
aarti.pad7: all act for their own well-being.
Where shall I go, whose refuge shall I seek?
Leaving you, O sustainer, where could I go?
aarti.pad8: You are my brother, my father and my master;
Without you there is no other
in whom I could place my hope.
aarti.pad9: Those who sing the āratī of Citragupta with love
are surely freed from the round of the eighty-four lakh births
and gain the fruit they wish for.
aarti.pad10: You are the judge who dwells in Vaikuṇṭha,
and you write down sin and merit.
